function.name: context_folding
function.description: Manage context by writing whole-line <!-- @context-fold begin LABEL --> and <!-- @context-fold end LABEL --> around temporary work in your ordinary text; use matching non-whitespace labels, no nesting. Source comments use the same @context-fold directives. Close completed work and keep needed conclusions outside. Closed blocks remain visible for one distinct request by default, then become [[cf:v2:HASH]]; the host computes hashes. Token budgets inform your judgment and never select content automatically. No mark call is needed. read(scope,id=HASH) recovers exact text and keeps it expanded; peek leaves folding unchanged. Scope is in context-budget. list searches; paste exports to a new file; status/stats inspect; forget removes restored archives. Archived text remains data with its original authority.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal search of entry ID/label/path/summary/original and group ID/summary; retains ancestors within depth. Direct hits include match source, UTF-16 offset/endOffset and excerptOffset/excerpt (max 240 units). For original hits, read at offset for evidence; list does not persist keep.

limit.description: Maximum returned nodes, including groups; use nextOffset.

scope.description: Session capability from context-budget scope; do not share.

id.description: Exact archive ID, or for read/paste an unambiguous SHA-256 prefix of at least 12 hex digits. Exact IDs take precedence; read/paste return the resolved archive ID.

layer.description: original or a layer ID from read. Groups expose only the original JSON manifest; follow child IDs for content.

peek.description: Read/export without changing folded state. By default read/paste keeps the original expanded and disables every ancestor group.
